task: Predict whether this startup founder's company will succeed (exit, IPO or funding over $500M).

rules.question: Has the founder previously founded a company that was acquired or went public?
Has the founder had an exit worth $50M or more as a co-founder?
Is this the founder's first startup?
Does the founder have a technical background, such as engineering or computer science?
Does the founder hold a degree from a university ranked in the QS top 100?
Does the founder hold a graduate degree (master's, MBA, PhD or equivalent)?
Does the founder have more than 10 years of work experience?
Does the founder have deep prior experience in the startup's industry?
Has the founder worked at a company with more than 1,000 employees?
Has the founder held a senior engineering or technical leadership role?
Has the founder held a management or leadership role?
Did the founder start the company with at least one co-founder?
Does the founding team have three or more people?
Has the founder spent five or more years with a single employer?
Has the founder worked in a technical or product role at a company with 1,000 or fewer employees?
Has the founder worked in the same industry as the startup?
Has the founder spent most of their career at organisations with more than 5,000 employees?
Does the founder have less than five years of work experience?
Is the founder a domain specialist, such as a clinician or scientist?
Has the founder changed industries more than twice?
